summary: Iter 58 — Slide image_position + bulk photo upload. Backend pytest (5/5) and Playwright UI e2e (create draft course, upload image slide, pick 'beside', save+reload persistence, bulk 3-photo upload creates 3 IMAGE slides w/ titles from filenames, save+reload persistence, set 2nd slide 'behind', publish, /learn/{id} verifies image-layout-above/beside/behind data-testids all render for their respective slides, /learn/224 regression loads, cleanup unpublish+delete). Everything passes.

issues: Two 500s appear in browser console during /learn navigation (background call, likely /api/catalog/{cid}/slides/{sid}/track-view or similar analytics). Non-blocking; the player renders fine. Main agent may want to inspect backend logs and swallow silently.

action_items: Investigate the two 500 responses observed on /learn/{courseId} (background XHRs — likely track-view or another analytics endpoint). The UI recovers gracefully but backend log noise should be checked.
critical_code_review_comments: courses.py::update_slide swaps image_position only if value is one of {above,beside,behind}. If a caller sends an invalid value on PATCH, existing value is silently kept (unlike POST which forces 'above'). Consider unifying the behaviour or documenting it. Not blocking.
add_slide/update_slide duplicate the SlideOut construction — minor DRY, could be a shared _slide_out helper.
CourseEditPage.tsx addPhotoSlides doesn't rollback previously created remote uploads if one file fails mid-loop; slides array reflects the partial success (this is actually fine + user is warned).
seed_data_creation: Draft test course TEST_UI_ImgPos_<ts> created and deleted (id 243 during this run). No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend login for UAT admin returns access_token in the response body (cookie+bearer dual). Use page.request.post from a Playwright context OR pytest requests directly. In browser-automation env, plain urllib had a 403 issue (blocked/proxied); using Playwright's page.request works. Data-testids: slide-image-upload-input, slide-image-preview, image-position-picker, image-position-{above|beside|behind}, add-photo-slides-btn/input, image-layout-{above|beside|behind}, learn-slide-image.
